manual_checks.description: Register, login, logout and role-based admin access work.
Semantic, OCR and image search are accessible from the UI.
Image query supports drag/drop, preview and crop before search.
Top-20 results render in a responsive grid/masonry layout.
Loading skeleton, empty state and server/network errors are clear.
Upload, CLIP and OCR progress survives navigation/reload.
The complete system starts successfully with Docker Compose.

label_review.protocol: Relevant khi ảnh thực sự đáp ứng truy vấn; image search xét đối tượng, bối cảnh và độ giống trực quan. Independent sampled second review; disagreements resolved by blind adjudication.
label_review.candidate_pool: Top results from supplied evaluation report plus independent Unsplash/OCR metadata candidates
